run_prepare_scannet_data: run the script to convert ScanNet PLY mesh and label files into PyTorch .pth tensors
create_function_process_ply: create a function that reads a PLY file, extracts vertex coordinates and colors, and remaps semantic labels
build_scannet_label_remapper: build a label remapper array that maps ScanNet class IDs to {0..19} and ignored classes to -100
run_parallel_ply_conversion: run parallel PLY-to-PTH conversion across all ScanNet scenes using multiprocessing pool
test_scannet_data_pipeline: test the ScanNet data preparation pipeline by verifying PLY files match their label files before conversion
